text:
emily-sales: FYI sales request — large demo from Neurolytics on Wed 09:00 SGT (asia-southeast1). They want a low-latency demo for 1.5k concurrent users for ~3 hours. Can we get a short-lived quota bump + priority routing? They're sensitive to max queueing.

kai_infra: what's the model, token estimates, and peak concurrency you expect? Need those to size the request. Also which exact zone? asia-southeast1 has mixed capacity today. :thinking:

emily-sales: thanks — model tuned-llama-64q, typical prompt+response ~1.2k tokens per request. Peak concurrency target 1500, steady 800. Zone: asia-southeast1-a preferred but can fall back to -b. Demo runs 09:00–12:00 SGT.

alex_w: rough back-of-envelope: 1500 concurrent * 1.2k tokens * 3 hours = big. We'll hit admission control immediately without extra capacity or routing. Two options: (1) temporary quota bump of GPU slots in asia-southeast1, or (2) route demo traffic to dedicated west1-d pool and enable cross-region priority routing. Cross-region adds latency; are they okay with 60–120ms extra?

jonathan_m: finance sig needed for option (1) due to reserved capacity costs. For (2) we'll need a quick canary and to set fallback policies so we don't overload west1. I can approve ephemeral routing config if infra confirms no safety risk.

emily-sales: client insists on <100ms RTT if possible. They said demo experience will fall apart at higher latency. So cross-region not ideal.

kai_infra: ok. I'll do a short capacity audit. Can someone paste the recent queue/backpressure numbers? ops-oncall, can you grab the last 6h admission control trends for asia-southeast1?

ops-oncall: pulling now. quick check:
```
rbqctl metrics admission --region asia-southeast1 --window 6h --series "queue.depth,p99.latency,admit.reject_rate"
# sample output (truncated):
# queue.depth: baseline 30 -> spike 420 at 02:10 UTC
# p99.latency: baseline 90ms -> 220ms at spikes
# admit.reject_rate: 0.5% -> 7.4% during peak
```

ops-oncall: summary — yesterday we saw intermittent backpressure in a couple AZs, but current scheduled maintenance (kernel upgrades) will finish tonight. Capacity is borderline for a 1500 concurrent session demo.

alex_w: given RTT constraint, we should target a temporary quota bump plus admission-control tweak for the demo window: increase per-customer token concurrency for that org to avoid throttling while keeping global safety. I can prepare the admission-control patch (small change) and a rollback. Will need an API token and change request recorded.

sally_support: filed a formal capacity-exception request: https://internal.redwood/requests/CE-9922. Included client org id, timestamps, and estimated token consumption. Please add approvals/comments there.

emily-sales: added cost approval from Neurolytics (they'll cover overage). I also attached the demo playbook and expected traffic pattern.

kai_infra: quick checklist for us: 1) confirm available spare GPUs in asia-southeast1-a/b, 2) create short-lived admission policy for org with higher concurrency, 3) pre-populate KV cache for demo prompts to reduce cost/latency, 4) enable stricter tracing for that org to watch regressions. I'll run steps 1 & 3 now.

deploy-bot: [capacity-check] asia-southeast1 available GPUs: 34 free (after reserved pools), projected free during Wed 09:00 SGT window: 12–18 depending on autoscaler.

kai_infra: 12–18 is tight. I'll see if we can temporarily borrow 8 GPUs from staging (low traffic Wed morning) and mark them as ephemeral for CE-9922. Canops?

ops-oncall: staging borrowing OK if we set autoscaler min for staging to 0 for that window and verify no scheduled jobs. I'll coordinate with workload owners.

jonathan_m: please estimate incremental cost for the ephemeral GPUs and add to CE-9922. Need number for finance sign-off.

alex_w: prepping the admission-control change, will namespace it under demo-ce9922 and push a canary config for 09:00–12:00. Plan: raise org concurrency limit from 50 -> 500, enable KV prefill, set rollback timer at 12:30.

emily-sales: perfect. Can we get a final go/no-go by Tue EOD? Client will confirm on Tue morning but wants internal readiness earlier. :crossed_fingers:

kai_infra: I'll aim for Tue 18:00 SGT with a short playbook and one-click rollback steps in the doc. Adding a health-check we can monitor: /internal/health/queues?org=neurolytics with alert threshold p99>160ms or reject_rate>3%.

sally_support: CE-9922 updated with cost estimate and approvals from Neurolytics. tagging @finance for final ack.

ops-oncall: I'll also prepare escalation contacts and a hotfix runbook in case admission-control causes global regressions.

emily-sales: thanks team. please ping me once CE-9922 is green and the borrow is secured. We'll align with the client after that. :thumbsup:
